decisions.reason: Report grounds attempt 1 in ls-remote-tags.txt (list jumps v0.9.1 to v0.9.7, so v0.9.5 is absent) and in sync-script.sh pushing only HEAD:main with no tag refspec, explicitly rejecting network/command explanations.

Uses dsh-version.txt (0.1.1-rc.2) and compat-table.md (v0.9.7 targets 0.1.2-alpha.1) to explain that the alpha-API artifact lacks the useConversation seat on the older runtime, states the newer-plugin-to-newer-runtime direction, and notes restarting cannot fix a deterministic API mismatch.

Correctly honors the freeze, notices v0.9.3 is also missing from the mirror, and conditionally names #v0.9.3 as preferable after tag back-fill, but the concrete install command pins unverified-by-table v0.9.1 instead of providing the required #v0.9.3 command (or verified v0.9.3 commit) as the remedy.

Proposes git push "$remote" --tags or an explicit refs/tags/* refspec after the branch push, grounded in the branch-only sync script, plus a post-release ls-remote comparison gate and CI assertion that README-pinned tags resolve on each mirror.

Requires a README plugin-tag-to-DSH-runtime compatibility matrix with per-tag version callouts, default install example naming the tag matching the supported runtime instead of a blanket newest-tag default, and an alpha.1+ note beside the command, without generalizing to untested future releases.
